reason: The README clearly describes a DSH multimodal integration whose primary user-facing purpose is image understanding, text-to-image generation, image-to-image editing, and image handling in chat.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图像理解、文生图、图生图编辑及对话图片处理能力。
summaries.en: Adds image understanding, text-to-image generation, image-to-image editing, and image handling in DeepSeek Harness conversations.

capabilities: Sends image inputs and prompts to the Agnes AI service for image understanding and image generation
Generates images from text prompts and edits images using reference inputs
Decodes incoming image content and writes hashed image files to the session workspace
Integrates image handling into chat messages through a vision bridge
Reads the AGNES_API_KEY credential at runtime
